NewsArticle.Title: New Testers Accepted
NewsArticle.Content: Applications accepted through St. Patrick's Day Dark Ages continues accepting applications for role-playing beta testers through 99.03.17, honoring St. Patrick's Day. Private beta-testing for talented role-players will be offered on these dates: - 99.03.17: Test Application final deadline - Spring, 1999: Dark Ages release Apply: [www.darkages.com/test](http://www.darkages.com/test/index.html).
